speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh. It's Stuart.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're not going to answer it?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: He wants to talk about Penny. I don't want to talk about Penny.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're making an assumption. Perhaps the comic book store is on fire, and he needs your assistance.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why would he call me?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: We don't know. And if you don't answer the phone, we can't know.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not answering the phone, Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Answer the phone, Leonard.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No! There, it went to voice mail.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Aren't you going to check your messages?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You have to check your messages, the leaving of a message is one half of a social contract which is completed by the checking of the message. If that contract breaks down then all social contracts break down and we descend into anarchy.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: It must be hell inside your head.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: At times.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Guys, we have a code red.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Do you mean code red the hospital emergency alert, code red the computer worm, or code red the cherry flavoured soft drink from the makers of Mountain Dew?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Look, I was going over the schematics on my zero-G toilet, and I made a teeny tiny mistake on the specifications for the diverter valve.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: How teeny tiny?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: It's gonna fail after about ten flushes.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: But the mission is for six months.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Yeah, see, that's the code red. It's kind of like a jack-in-the-box, no one knows exactly when, but at some point something way worse than a puppet is gonna pop out of that box.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Have you notified NASA?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No. Are you crazy?What am I gonna say? I screwed up your toilet and pretty soon there's gonna be crap floating all over your nice shiny space station?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, what are you gonna do?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I'm gonna figure out how to fix it, then I'll tell them.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So, what do you need us for?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: He can't figure out how to fix it.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Hey, you said you were gonna be supportive.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I'm trying, but you have to admit this is pretty damn funny.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I agree. It's the juxtaposition of the high-tech nature of space exploration against the banality of a malfunctioning toilet that provides the comic fodder here.
